name: square
description: Read a uint256 from calldata and return its square as 32 raw bytes.
notes: Difficulty is the baseline, and the rule is unforgiving: matching it or doing worse scores zero.

baselineGas is set to 1264, which is what the implementation a person writes first actually costs over these eight vectors — PUSH1 0, CALLDATALOAD, DUP1, MUL, PUSH1 0, MSTORE, PUSH1 32, PUSH1 0, RETURN. Submitting that earns nothing. The measured floor is 1232, and the whole margin between the two is 32 gas, so the only way to score is to have searched.
Windows are five minutes each on purpose. A miner client commits, waits and reveals in seconds; a person acting by hand does not finish inside them. This task is for machines.
Vectors include 0, 1 and 2^128-1 so an answer cannot special-case the small cases and skip the arithmetic.

If nobody scores, the ASSAY pot returns through Tournament.reclaim and the BTCB through AssayFlapVault.reclaimBounty, both immediately once the reveal window closes. An empty round costs the project nothing but the gas.
